name: main
sql: SELECT toDate(TimeUnixMs) AS day, sum(greatest((InputTokens + CacheReadTokens + CacheCreationTokens) - 450000, 0)) / 1e6 * 0.3 AS usd FROM agent_session_events WHERE EventKind = 'model_call' AND TimeUnixMs >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND TimeUnixMs < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime} GROUP BY day ORDER BY day
